description.what_it_is: An overnight leave-on lip mask powered by Korean skincare to soften lips while delivering intense moisture and antioxidants while you sleep. Enriched with Berry Fruit Complex, Murumuru Seed, and Shea butter.
description.concerns_text: Loss of Firmness/Elasticity, Dryness, and Dullness

Coconut Oil, Shea Butter, and Murumuru Seed Butter: Help nourish & deliver lasting moisture while you sleep.

-Apply generously to the lips in the evening and leave on overnight.
-Gently wipe off excess in the morning as needed.

highlighted_ingredients: 베리 프룻 콤플렉스: 항산화 성분이 풍부해 매끄럽고 탄력 있는 입술로 가꾸어 줍니다.

description.what_it_is: A protein moisturizer that combines signal peptides, growth factors, amino acids, and pygmy waterlily to visibly improve skin‘s tone, texture, and firmness.
description.concerns_text: Dryness, Dullness and Uneven Texture, and Loss of Firmness and Elasticity
highlighted_ingredients: Signal Peptide Complex (Growth Factors): Nine signal peptides (made up of amino
acids, which form proteins in the skin) bind moisture to skin—visibly plumping, firming,
and restoring bounce.
Pygmy Waterlily Stem Cell Extract: An excellent source of antioxidants and nutrients to replenish the skin.
description.suggested_usage:
-Apply morning and night to clean, dry skin for a vital dose of protein and replenishing moisture the skin needs to retain its youthful appearance.
- Tip: Think of ProtiniTM in your Drunk Elephant skincare routine like adding a shot of protein to your smoothie everyday.
Smoothie Tips:
Try our “Own Your Power Smoothie” for firmer, hydrated, younger-looking skin. In the palm of your hand mix one pump of B-Hydra, one pump of Protini Serum , and one pump of Protini™ and apply to skin.

How To Refill:
1. Remove cap and unscrew pump.
2. Remove empty inner jar.
3. Insert refill pod into outer jar and remove film seal.
4. Immediately screw pump back on tightly.
Do not touch product or underside of pump to avoid contamination.
How To Recycle Refill:
Wait! Don’t throw me away—I’m recyclable!
description.brand_story: Since 2012, Drunk Elephant has pioneered a skin- and hair-care philosophy that is as radical as it is simple. Get rid of anything that is irritating, sensitizing, disruptive, or inflammatory, and replace it with smart, biocompatible ingredients the skin recognizes and embraces. We call the culprits the Suspicious 6—essential oils, drying alcohols, silicones, chemical sunscreens, fragrances/dyes, and SLS—and you will never find any of them in our line. Instead, we formulate our products with powerful, safe, biocompatible ingredients that bring skin and scalp back to their healthiest, most balanced, most radiant state. That’s our ingredient-elimination philosophy for a total skin reset.

descriptionKo.what_it_is: 시그널 펩타이드, 성장 인자, 아미노산, 피그미 워터릴리를 결합한 단백질 모이스처라이저로 피부 톤, 질감, 탄력을 눈에 띄게 개선해 줍니다.
descriptionKo.suggested_usage:
- 아침과 저녁, 깨끗하고 건조한 피부에 발라 건강하고 탄력 있는 피부를 위한 단백질과 수분을 공급하세요.
- 팁: Drunk Elephant 스킨케어 루틴에서 Protini™는 매일 스무디에 단백질을 추가하는 것과 같습니다.
스무디 팁:
더 탄탄하고 촉촉하며 젊어 보이는 피부를 위해 'Own Your Power Smoothie'를 시도해 보세요. 손바닥에 B- Hydra 1펌프, Protini 세럼 1펌프, Protini™ 1펌프를 섞어 피부에 발라줍니다.

리필 방법:
1. 캡을 제거하고 펌프를 돌려 분리합니다.
2. 빈 내부 용기를 제거합니다.
3. 리필 팟을 외부 용기에 넣고 필름 씰을 제거합니다.
4. 즉시 펌프를 단단히 다시 조입니다.
오염을 방지하려면 내용물과 펌프 안쪽을 손으로 만지지 마세요.
리필 재활용 방법:
잠깐! 버리지 마세요—재활용 가능합니다!
highlighted_ingredients: 시그널 펩타이드 콤플렉스 (성장 인자): 아미노산으로 구성된 9가지 시그널 펩타이드가 피부에 수분을 결합시켜 눈에 띄게 볼륨감과 탄력을 부여하고 탄성을 회복시켜 줍니다.
피그미 워터릴리 줄기 세포 추출물: 피부에 항산화 및 영양을 공급하여 피부에 영양과 생기를 더하는 탁월한 성분입니다.
descriptionKo.brand_story: 2012년부터 Drunk Elephant 는 급진적이면서도 단순한 스킨·헤어케어 철학을 앞장서 왔습니다. 자극적이거나 민감하게 만들거나 피부 균형을 흔들거나 염증을 일으키는 것은 모두 빼고, 피부가 알아보고 반기는 똑똑한 생체친화 성분으로 채웁니다. 우리는 그 주범들을 '의심스러운 여섯 가지(Suspicious 6)' 라고 부릅니다. 에센셜 오일, 건조를 부르는 알코올, 실리콘, 화학 자외선차단 성분, 향료·색소, SLS 입니다. 우리 라인에서는 이 여섯 가지를 절대 찾을 수 없습니다. 대신 강력하고 안전한 생체친화 성분으로 처방해 피부와 두피를 가장 건강하고 균형 잡히고 빛나는 상태로 되돌립니다. 이것이 피부를 완전히 리셋하는 우리의 '성분 제거 철학' 입니다.

Powered by 12 antioxidants, Step 2 neutralizes acid activity, hydrates, and defends against visible signs of aging.
description.clinical_results:
Based on a daily-use study using the Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel, results included:
- 92% saw smoother skin immediately (27 subjects)

 When you spot our Clean seal, you can be sure we’ve checked that this brand’s product is made without the ingredients you told us you’d most like to avoid.

description.suggested_usage:
-If you’re doing one thing for your skin, it should be quality cleansing.

-Use twice daily in the morning and evening.

-Wet face first. Put one to two pumps into wet hands, rub together into a light lather, and massage into face and neck for 30 seconds to activate the cold-pressed antioxidants.

-Rinse thoroughly.

-Tip: For best makeup removal, massage one to two pumps into slightly damp face and neck. Add more water gradually as you massage for one minute. Rinse thoroughly.

- 아침과 저녁, 하루 두 번 사용하세요.

- 먼저 얼굴을 적신 후, 1~2펌프를 젖은 손에 덜어 가볍게 거품을 내어 얼굴과 목에 30초간 마사지해 콜드프레스 항산화 성분을 활성화하세요.

- 깨끗이 헹구어 냅니다.

- 팁: 메이크업 제거 시에는 1~2펌프를 약간 젖은 얼굴과 목에 마사지하세요. 마사지하면서 점차 물을 더해 1분간 문지른 후 깨끗이 헹굽니다.
descriptionKo.what_else:
케일, 시금치, 녹차로 강력하면서도 부드럽게 매일 사용할 수 있는 페이스 워시입니다. 이중 세안에도 효과적이며, 황산염과 알코올이 없고 동물 실험을 하지 않은 100% 비건 제품입니다. 유리병에 담겨 있어 순수함을 유지하며 식물성 영양소를 보존합니다.

이 제품은 2018년 GQ 매거진 베스트 스터프 어워드 수상작입니다.

클린 인증 마크가 보이면, 고객님께서 피하고 싶어 하시는 성분이 포함되지 않은 제품임을 확인한 것입니다.

description.what_it_is: A breakthrough blemish-healing dot that combines hydrocolloid technology with active anti-acne ingredients to minimize breakouts overnight.
description.what_else: Peace Out Acne uses hydrocolloid technology—a soothing, absorbent, waterproof bandage used for decades by doctors to speed skin healing. This innovative material gently extracts impurities, protects skin moisture, and creates a protective barrier against irritants. While hydrocolloid technology has been used for years to treat acne, these dots are the first to combine the healing power of hydrocolloid bandages with active anti-acne ingredients. The addition of blemish-fighting extracts creates the ideal environment for speedy relief from breakouts. These Acne Healing Dots effectively adhere to the skin (without causing irritation) and deliver a powerful dose of anti-acne ingredients while keeping the skin hydrated and comfortable for hours. They are latex-free, cruelty-free, and noncomedogenic.
description.suggested_usage:
-After cleansing, apply a sticker, tacky-side down, on your blemish.
-For best results, wear for six hours.
description.brand_story: Peace Out was made by real people who tried everything to get rid of their skin imperfections. Frustrated with breakouts and poor results, they set out to create something that really works. Their easy one-step solutions combine active ingredients with innovative technology so you can stop thinking about your skin and start feeling great.

description.what_else: For immediate hydration anytime and anywhere, this ultra-rich cream formula delivers intense hydration and a radiant glow. It can be used as an overnight or 10-minute mask, as your morning and evening moisturizer, or as a hand cream. It's formulated for all skin types, including eczema-prone and sensitive skin.
description.clinical_results:
In a consumer study with 33 participants (aged 25–55) using Jet Lag Mask, results included:
- 100% of participants saw an increase in moisturization and hydration 8 hours after application
- 97% thought their skin felt softer, smoother, and soothed 8 hours after application
- 94% noticed an improvement in overall skin texture 8 hours after application
description.suggested_usage:
-To use as a daytime or nighttime moisturizer, massage a lighter layer into your skin and leave on.
-To use as a mask, apply a thin, even layer to clean, dry skin. After leaving on for at least 10 minutes, remove any excess with a warm cloth.
-To use as an overnight mask, apply a thin, even layer to clean, dry skin before bed and leave on.
-To use as an eye cream, gently apply a pea-sized amount around the contour of each eye morning or night.
-To use as a hand or body cream, apply generously wherever you need skin-soothing moisture.
description.brand_story: When you work this hard but still want soft, healthy-looking skin, @marianna_hewitt and @laurengores have got your back—and your beauty routine. We’re product connoisseurs who battle our own dull, tired, stressed-out complexions (hello, NYC-LAX red-eye) and set out to create skincare formulas with good-for-you ingredients and covetable results. Relieving stressed-out skin so everyday feels like a Summer Friday.

description.what_it_is: A rich cream that feeds skin with plumping hydration and antioxidant-packed Japanese purple rice for a dewy, healthy glow.
description.concerns_text: Dryness, Dullness and Uneven Texture, and Loss of Firmness and Elasticity
highlighted_ingredients: Japanese Purple Rice: Packed with nutrients and known for its ability to survive any harsh environment, it has long been used to celebrate longevity and vitality; rich in anthocyanin, a strong antioxidant, it helps skin recover from and protect against stress, pollution, and UV damage for healthier-looking skin.

Okinawa Algae Blend and Hyaluronic Acid: Captures water to help replenish skin’s natural moisture reservoir, immediately leaving skin soft, comforted, and deeply nourished; helps to replenish ceramides to ensure optimum skin barrier function, aiding in the reduction of future moisture loss, for skin that is visibly smooth and plump with hydration.
Botanical Extracts: From ginseng, wild thyme, and sweet marjoram; nourishes skin, enhancing its natural ability to retain and release moisture as needed, and imparts a dewy glow.
description.ingredient_callouts: This product is cruelty-free, and gluten-free.
description.what_else: This cream intensely hydrates and seals in moisture, helping to replenish ceramides for a healthy bounce and instant luminosity.  A fermentation of Japanese anti-aging superfoods—green tea, rice, and algae—helps skin to look its most beautiful at any age.
description.clinical_results:
In an expert grader survey of 20 subjects, after 2 weeks:

- 100% experienced an increase in hydration

- 100% experienced an improvement in the radiance of their skin

- 100% experienced an improvement in the plumpness of their skin

- 100% experienced an improvement in the texture of their skin

- 95% experienced an improvement in firmness

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is a curation of brands committed to evolving the beauty industry. When you see our Clean seal, you can be sure this brand's products are formulated without certain ingredients that are potentially harmful to human health and the environment and also address ingredients clients are concerned about, including phthalates, formaldehyde or formaldehyde releasers, oxybenzone and octinoxate, hydroquinone, triclosan, coal tar, methylisothiazolinone and methylchloroisothiazolinone, insoluble plastic microbeads, and more. For the full list, check out the Ingredients tab.
description.suggested_usage:
-Scoop a pearl-sized amount of cream with the gold spoon.
-Massage onto face, neck, and décolletage in upward strokes.
-Use daily, morning and night.
description.brand_story: For over 300 years, Japan’s geisha have been held in awe for their enduring wisdom and breathtakingly beautiful, porcelain skin. Perfected through centuries, it’s widely believed that their beauty secrets were passed down from one generation of geisha to the next by word of mouth alone. TATCHA rediscovered these coveted daily regimes in a 200-year-old manuscript. In homage to these icons of Eastern beauty, a proprietary process was developed with scientists, scholars, and geisha themselves, involving the very best green teas, Okinawa red algae, and rice bran. The secrets of the geisha live on in TATCHA.

descriptionKo.what_it_is: 풍부한 크림으로 피부에 촉촉한 수분과 항산화 성분이 가득한 일본 퍼플 라이스를 공급하여 촉촉하고 건강한 광채를 선사합니다.
descriptionKo.suggested_usage:
- 골드 스푼으로 진주 크기만큼 크림을 덜어냅니다.
- 얼굴, 목, 데콜테 부위에 위쪽 방향으로 마사지하듯 발라줍니다.
- 아침과 저녁 매일 사용하세요.
descriptionKo.what_else: 이 크림은 강력한 수분 공급과 수분 잠금 효과로 세라마이드를 보충하여 건강한 탄력과 즉각적인 광채를 선사합니다. 일본의 안티에이징 케어 슈퍼푸드인 녹차, 쌀, 해조류의 발효 성분이 나이에 상관없이 피부가 가장 아름답게 보이도록 도와줍니다.
highlighted_ingredients: Japanese Purple Rice: 영양소가 풍부하며 어떤 혹독한 환경에서도 생존하는 능력으로 오래전부터 장수와 활력을 기념하는 데 사용되어 왔습니다. 강력한 항산화제인 안토시아닌이 풍부하여 피부가 스트레스, 오염, 자외선 손상으로부터 회복하고 보호하여 건강해 보이는 피부로 가꿔줍니다.
Okinawa Algae Blend and Hyaluronic Acid: 수분을 포획하여 피부의 자연 수분 저장고를 보충하는 데 도움을 주며 즉시 피부를 부드럽고 편안하게, 깊이 영양을 공급합니다. 세라마이드를 보충하여 최적의 피부 장벽 기능을 보장하고 미래의 수분 손실을 줄여 눈에 띄게 매끄럽고 촉촉한 피부로 가꿔줍니다.
Botanical Extracts: 인삼, 야생 타임, 스위트 마조람에서 추출한 식물성 성분으로 피부를 영양 공급하며 필요에 따라 수분을 유지하고 방출하는 자연스러운 능력을 향상시키고 촉촉한 광채를 부여합니다.
descriptionKo.ingredient_callouts: 이 제품은 크루얼티 프리 제품이며 글루텐 프리입니다.
descriptionKo.brand_story: 300년 이상 일본 게이샤는 그들의 지혜와 도자기처럼 맑고 아름다운 피부로 찬사를 받아왔습니다. 수세기에 걸쳐 완성된 이들의 미용 비법은 구전으로 세대를 이어 내려온 것으로 널리 알려져 있습니다. TATCHA는 200년 된 고문서에서 이 소중한 일상 루틴을 재발견했습니다. 동양 미인의 아이콘에 경의를 표하며, 과학자, 학자, 게이샤와 함께 최고의 녹차, 오키나와 적조류, 쌀겨를 활용한 독자적인 공정을 개발했습니다. 게이샤의 비밀은 TATCHA에 살아 숨 쉽니다.
descriptionKo.clinical_results:
전문 평가자 20명을 대상으로 한 조사에서 2주 후:

- 100%가 수분 증가를 경험함

- 100%가 피부 광채 개선을 경험함

- 100%가 피부 탄력 개선을 경험함

- 100%가 피부결 개선을 경험함

- 95%가 피부 탄력 개선을 경험함

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora는 뷰티 산업의 발전에 헌신하는 브랜드를 엄선한 컬렉션입니다. Clean 마크가 붙은 제품은 인체 건강과 환경에 잠재적으로 해로운 특정 성분을 배제하고, 프탈레이트, 포름알데히드 및 방출제, 옥시벤존과 옥티녹세이트, 하이드로퀴논, 트리클로산, 콜타르, 메틸이소티아졸리논 및 메틸클로로이소티아졸리논, 불용성 플라스틱 마이크로비드 등 고객이 우려하는 성분을 포함하지 않음을 보장합니다. 전체 목록은 성분 탭을 참고하세요.

description.what_it_is: A collection of cleansing and makeup-removing wipes, each with a skin-refreshing benefit.
description.what_else: No need to rinse. These wipes are clinically proven suitable for all skin types. Each pack contains 25 wipes and is ideal for travel.
description.clinical_results:
Coconut Water Cleansing Wipes:
In a use test on 31 volunteers after first use:
- 87% said that the wipes left skin feeling soft
- 71% said that sensations of tightness disappeared

Rose Cleansing Wipes:
In a use test on 31 volunteers after first use:
- 100% said that the wipes quenched the skin's thirst
- 87% said that their faces appeared instantly more radiant
- 87% said that skin looked more luminous

Yuzu Cleansing Wipes:
In a use test on 33 volunteers after first use:
- 94% said that the wipes toned skin
- 91% said that skin felt softer
- 82% said that the wipes energized skin

Green Tea Exfoliating Wipes:
In a use test on 29 volunteers after first use:
- 90% said that the wipes absorbed excess sebum effectively

Charcoal Cleansing Wipes:
In a use test on 30 volunteers after first use:
- 100% said that the wipes detoxified skin
- 97% said that the wipes purified skin
- 97% said that the wipes cleansed skin effectively
description.suggested_usage:
Cleansing Wipes:
-Gently wipe over the face and eyes.
-No need to rinse.
-Close wipe latch well after each use to avoid drying out.

Exfoliating Wipes:
-To eliminate impurities and dead cells, use the exfoliating side to scrub the face delicately with specific attention to the T zone.
-To cleanse the face gently and remove makeup, use the smooth side, and gently wipe all over the face.
-No need to rinse.
-Close wipe latch well after each use to avoid drying out.

 Precautions:
-Cleansing Wipes:
-Do not dispose improperly.

Exfoliating Wipes:
-Avoid contact with the eyes. In case of contact, rinse thoroughly.
-Do not dispose improperly.

description.ingredient_callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, phthalates, mineral oil, oxybenzone, coal tar, and sulfates SLS & SLES. It is also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.
description.what_else: This 7% Toning Solution offers mild exfoliation for visibly improved skin radiance and clarity. The formula also improves the appearance of skin texture with continued use. This product is vegan, cruelty-free, and formulated without oil, alcohol, silicone, nuts, gluten, and fragrance.
description.suggested_usage:
-Use ideally in the PM and do not exceed once-daily use.
-After cleaning, saturate a cotton pad with the formula and sweep across face and neck.
-Do not rinse off.
-Continue with additional skin treatments as needed.

Precautions:
-Avoid the eye contour and contact with eyes.
-This product contains an alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) that may increase your skin's sensitivity to the sun and particularly the possibility of sunburn. Use a sunscreen, wear protective clothing, and limit sun exposure while using this product and for a week afterward.
-Use only as directed.
-Contact of the product with the skin must be of limited frequency or duration.
-This formula should not be used on sensitive, peeling, or compromised skin. If persistent irritation occurs, discontinue use and consult a physician.
-Please note that Tasmanian pepperberry derivative included in this formula is of plant origin and varies in color seasonally, and this color variation may be apparent in the formula from time to time.

descriptionKo.brand_story: Isle of Paradise와 함께 당신만의 빛을 소유하세요. 세계 최초의 색 보정, 맞춤형, 클린 셀프 태닝 컬렉션입니다. 비건 및 크루얼티 프리로, 모든 바디를 위한 자기애, 자기관리, 셀프 태닝을 약속합니다. 각 IoP 쉐이드는 독특한 색 보정 복합체로 피부를 밝히고 붉은 기를 줄이며 피부 톤을 균형 있게 맞춥니다. 코코넛, 아보카도, 자몽, 치아씨드 등 유기농 성분과 유칼립투스, 페퍼민트의 편안한 향이 피부에 좋은 효과를 주며 줄무늬, 냄새, 오렌지 톤 없이 자연스러운 광채를 선사합니다. description.what_else:
Beste No. 9 is formulated at an ideal, non-stripping pH level of 5.9.

In Afrikaans, Beste means Best. Even though the first eight versions weren’t exactly that, Drunk Elephant thinks they’ve finally found the best one yet. They are calling it Beste No. 9 after going through nine formulations to get there! Only the Beste will do.

Note from Tiffany Masterson, Drunk Elephant Founder: we took your feedback about the original Beste and made some changes—we swapped out the twist top packaging for a trusty flip top and tweaked the formula so it’s gentle enough to use on eyes (and remove every last trace of makeup).

Drunk Elephant only uses clean ingredients that either directly benefit the skin's health or support the integrity and effectiveness of their formulations. They never take into account an ingredient's synthetic or natural status, but instead choose based on its safety and bio-compatibility. You won't find silicones, chemical sunscreens, sensitizing dyes, perfumes, or fragrant essential oils of any kind in any of their products, making them appropriate for every skin type. This is Drunk Elephant’s commitment to you. Drunk Elephant is a supporter of IEF (International Elephant Foundation) and is cruelty-free.

This product is a September 2017 Beauty O-Ward winner, Oprah Magazine.

- 매일 밤 사용하거나 다른 Drunk Elephant 클렌저와 교차 사용하세요.

descriptionKo.what_else:
Beste No. 9는 이상적인 pH 5.9로 피부를 자극하지 않는 포뮬러로 만들어졌습니다.


Afrikaans어로 Beste는 '최고'라는 뜻입니다. 첫 8가지 버전이 완벽하진 않았지만, Drunk Elephant는 마침내 최고의 제품을 찾았다고 생각합니다. 9번의 포뮬레이션을 거쳐 Beste No. 9라 이름 붙였죠! 오직 Beste만이 만족시킬 수 있습니다.


Drunk Elephant 창립자 Tiffany Masterson의 메모: 기존 Beste에 대한 여러분의 피드백을 반영해 몇 가지 변경을 했습니다—트위스트 탑 포장을 신뢰할 수 있는 플립 탑으로 바꾸고, 눈가에도 부드럽게 사용할 수 있도록 포뮬러를 조정해 메이크업 잔여물까지 완벽히 제거할 수 있게 했습니다.


Drunk Elephant는 피부 건강에 직접적으로 이롭거나 포뮬러의 효과와 안정성을 지원하는 깨끗한 성분만을 사용합니다. 성분의 합성 또는 천연 여부는 고려하지 않고, 안전성과 생체 적합성을 기준으로 선택합니다. 실리콘, 화학적 자외선 차단제, 자극성 염료, 향료, 향기 나는 에센셜 오일은 어떤 제품에도 포함하지 않아 모든 피부 타입에 적합합니다. 이것이 Drunk Elephant가 약속하는 바입니다. Drunk Elephant는 IEF(국제 코끼리 재단)를 후원하며 동물 실험을 하지 않습니다.

이 제품은 2017년 9월 오프라 매거진 뷰티 어워드 수상작입니다.

description.what_it_is: An AHA/BHA night serum that resurfaces congested skin by lifting away dead skin cells to improve skin tone, texture, fine lines, wrinkles, and pores.
description.concerns_text: Dullness and Uneven Texture, Pores, and Uneven Skin Tone
highlighted_ingredients: T.L.C. Framboos™ AHA Blend: (G) glycolic plus (T) tartaric, (L) lactic, and (C) citric acids) exfoliates built-up dead skin cells, resurfacing dull, uneven skin for a smoother, brighter, more even-looking complexion.
Salicylic Acid (BHA): Loosens sebum to unclog pores while soothing skin.
description.what_else:
With a blend of glycolic, tartaric, citric, and salicylic acids, T.L.C. Framboos™ delivers chemical exfoliation without dryness or sensitization, curbs excess oil, and reveals clarity and luminosity. It enhances the performance of other products by clearing the way for maximum absorption. pH 3.8.

 Drunk Elephant is clean, but in their opinion, "clean" is not enough when it comes to caring for skin. They make "Clean Compatible" skincare. Drunk Elephant is committed to using only ingredients that either directly benefit the skin’s health or support the integrity and effectiveness of their formulations. They never take into account an ingredient’s synthetic or natural status, but instead choose based on biocompatibility. You won’t find what they call the "Suspicious 6" in their products (essential oils, drying alcohols, silicones, chemical sunscreens, fragrances/dyes, and SLS) making them, in their opinion, appropriate for all skin. They believe that these six ubiquitous ingredients are at the root of almost every skin issue we see, and when entirely removed from one’s routine, ("a clean break"), skin can reset and return to a healthy, balanced state. It is equally, if not more, important what they leave out of the products as what they put in. This skin-elimination diet (think Whole30 for your face) inspired the #barewithus Instagram movement, a collection of bare-faced selfies chronicling the Drunk Elephant journeys of people who have found success using the line and renewed confidence in their own skin. When formulating their products, Drunk Elephant focuses on biocompatibility, pH levels, and safety, always making sure that the active ingredients are at efficacious levels and remain respectful and always supportive of skin’s acid mantle.

Drunk Elephant is a supporter of IEF (International Elephant Foundation) and is cruelty-free.

Award wins: 
- StyleCaster, 2017 Award for 15 Best Skin Serums
- New Beauty, 2017 Beauty Choice Award
- Real Simple, 2018 Road Test Award
description.clinical_results:
In an independent consumer-testing panel of 106 women age 25 to 55:
- 98% found skin was smoother
- 96% found skin was softer
- 93% found skin felt retexturized and refined

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is formulated without a list of over 50 ingredients, including sulfates (SLS and SLES), parabens, phthalates, and more. For the full list, check out the Ingredients tab.
description.suggested_usage:
-In the evening, apply to a clean, dry face, neck, chest, and backs of hands, avoiding the eye area.
-Mix with our Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil (sold separately) for maximum effectiveness.
-Note: A slight tingling may be experienced—particularly for the first few days of application. This typically dissipates as your skin becomes adjusted. Start slowly by using every other night.
-Tip: Also works incredibly well as a spot treatment!       
-Smoothie tip: Try Drunk Elephant’s “Oh What a Night Smoothie” for smoother, hydrated, more radiant skin. Mix one pump T.L.C. Framboos™ with one pump Lala Retro™ and one pump B-Hydra™.

descriptionKo.what_it_is: 각질을 제거해 피부 톤, 결, 잔주름, 주름, 모공을 개선하는 AHA/BHA 나이트 세럼입니다.
descriptionKo.suggested_usage:
- 저녁에 깨끗하고 건조한 얼굴, 목, 가슴, 손등에 눈가를 피해 발라줍니다.

- 참고: 처음 며칠간 약간의 따끔거림이 있을 수 있으나 피부가 적응하면서 사라집니다. 처음에는 격일로 사용하며 천천히 시작하세요.
- 팁: 국소 부위 트리트먼트로도 매우 효과적입니다!

descriptionKo.what_else:
글리콜산, 타르타르산, 시트릭산, 살리실산이 조합된 T.L.C. 프람부아™는 건조함이나 민감함 없이 화학적 각질 제거를 제공하며, 과도한 유분을 조절하고 맑고 빛나는 피부를 드러냅니다. 다른 제품의 흡수를 극대화할 수 있도록 피부를 정돈해줍니다. pH 3.8.

Drunk Elephant은 클린 뷰티 브랜드지만, 그들은 피부 관리에 있어 '클린'만으로는 충분하지 않다고 생각합니다. 그들은 '클린 호환성' 스킨케어를 만듭니다. Drunk Elephant은 피부 건강에 직접적으로 이롭거나 제형의 완성도와 효과를 지지하는 성분만을 사용합니다. 성분의 합성 또는 천연 여부는 고려하지 않고 생체 적합성을 기준으로 선택합니다. 그들은 '의심스러운 6가지'(에센셜 오일, 건조 알코올, 실리콘, 화학적 자외선 차단제, 향료/염료, SLS)를 제품에 포함하지 않아 모든 피부에 적합하다고 봅니다. 이 여섯 가지 성분이 거의 모든 피부 문제의 근원이라고 믿으며, 완전히 배제하면 ('클린 브레이크') 피부가 리셋되어 건강하고 균형 잡힌 상태로 돌아올 수 있다고 합니다. 제품에 넣는 성분만큼 빼는 성분도 중요합니다. 이 피부 제거 다이어트(얼굴을 위한 Whole30)에서 영감을 받은 #barewithus 인스타그램 운동은 Drunk Elephant 제품 사용 후 성공과 자신감을 찾은 사람들의 민낯 셀피 모음입니다. 제품을 개발할 때 Drunk Elephant은 생체 적합성, pH 수준, 안전성에 집중하며, 활성 성분이 효과적인 수준으로 유지되고 피부의 산성막을 존중하고 지지하도록 항상 신경 씁니다.

Drunk Elephant은 IEF(국제 코끼리 재단)를 후원하며 동물 실험을 하지 않습니다.

description.suggested_usage:
-Use after you cleanse and tone, but before you target and moisturize.
-Use daily, morning and night, to maximize skin repair.
-Facial Treatment Essence is safe for use around the eyes, including the lid itself.
-Pour the Facial Treatment Essence onto a cotton pad or into the palm of the hand, about five to 10 splashes, enough to soak the cotton pad or palm completely.
-Apply to both face and neck, pressing gently and evenly into skin until the essence has soaked in.
-Tap the skin lightly to enhance absorption.
description.brand_story: SK-II began at a sake brewery in Japan. Scientists noticed the elderly workers had wrinkled faces but extraordinarily soft and youthful-looking hands—thanks to Pitera™, a naturally derived liquid from the sake fermentation process. Since then, SK-II with Pitera™ has become a skin secret shared by actress Cate Blanchett and women around the world—it transforms the complexion’s texture, radiance, firmness, spot control, and wrinkle resilience. A leading skincare brand for more than 30 years, SK-II continues to deliver crystal clear skin through well-loved products including the Facial Treatment Essence, Essential Power Cream, and the Cellumination Essence.

description.what_it_is: New fast repair and youth-generating power: the next generation of the super serum that reduces the look of multiple signs of aging.
description.concerns_text: Fine Lines and Wrinkles, Dryness, and Dullness
highlighted_ingredients: Hyaluronic Acid: Helps lock in moisture for up to 72 hours.
description.ingredient_callouts: Free of sulfates SLS and SLES, parabens, phthalates, and mineral oil. This comes in recyclable packaging.
description.what_else: Experience the next generation of our revolutionary formula—the most comprehensive Advanced Night Repair serum ever. Patented until 2033. Now with Chronolux™ Power Signal Technology, this deep- and fast-penetrating face serum reduces the look of multiple signs of aging caused by the environmental assaults of modern life. Skin looks smoother and less lined, younger, more radiant and even toned. Proven effective for all skin tones.
description.clinical_results:
In consumer testing on 543 women, after 3 weeks:
- 88% of women said skin looked more youthful
- 89% of women agreed skin feels firmer
- Skin looks healthy with a new bounce and vitality
- Over time, pores look diminished
description.suggested_usage:
-Apply this face serum on clean skin before your moisturizer in the AM and PM.
-Use one dropper. Smooth in gently all over face and throat.

Try Estée Lauder‘s Heart Ritual:
-Apply a full dropper of the Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex to the palm of your hand.
-Massage onto your face in a heart shape. Using all fingers of both hands, start at the center of your face and move out to the ears.
-Glide hands from the sides of your face to down under chin.
-Next, trace a larger heart from the middle of your forehead out to the temples.
-Glide down the sides of the face and close the heart again under your chin.
-Finish by gently massaging onto your neck in a downward motion.
description.brand_story: Estée Lauder offers an unparalleled collection of skincare, makeup, and fragrance products, including bestsellers and proven solutions. As one of the world's most beloved and respected brands, the Estée Lauder name is recognized in over 100 countries as a symbol of quality, luxury, and promises kept.

- 한 방울을 덜어 얼굴과 목 전체에 부드럽게 펴 발라줍니다.

- 어드밴스드 나이트 리페어 싱크로나이즈드 멀티- 리커버리 컴플렉스 세럼 한 방울을 손바닥에 덜어냅니다.

- 얼굴 옆에서 턱 아래로 손을 미끄러뜨립니다.

A rich source of vitamins A, B2, B12, and E, this byproduct softens and boosts the look of luminosity. This original cleansing ritual was the inspiration for this wash, combining Okinawa red algae and hyaluronic acid with Japanese rice powder to replenish essential moisture for clean, hydrated skin.

Every Tatcha purchase supports equality in education through their Beautiful Faces, Beautiful Futures program.

 Geisha embraced and perfected the tradition of beauty waters as the foundation to their beauty ritual to restore and soften their skin. The secrets of the geisha live on in TATCHA.

description.what_it_is: A daily gel cleanser with natural fruit exfoliant that thoroughly but gently lifts impurities and unclogs pores while leaving skin soft and hydrated.
description.what_else:
Harvested under a full autumn moon, the water of luffa fruit has been prized as a favorite natural skincare ingredient in Japan since the Edo period. It is beloved for its clarifying and moisturizing properties. When dried and ground, the fruit gently exfoliates to purify and smooth skin texturethe original inspiration for the modern day loofah sponge. The Deep Cleanse harnesses this time-tested ingredient in this refreshing, easy-to-use daily exfoliating cleanser.

This pure, oil-free formula is non-irritating, non-sensitizing, dermatologist tested, and cruelty-free. It is formulated without synthetic fragrances, sulfate detergents, urea, DEA, of TEA.

This product is an Allure Best of Beauty award winner.

Beauty that gives back: every Tatcha purchase you make supports girls’ education around the world. Tatcha is proud to partner with Room to Read to transform girls’ futures.Victoria Tsai, Founder

CLEAN at Sephora is our commitment to offering formulas that go beyond regulatory standards to avoid controversial ingredients without sacrificing on effectiveness.

-Begin with wet hands and wet face.

-Gently massage the face avoiding the eye area and rinse thoroughly.
-Can be used daily.
description.brand_story: Tatcha is a celebration of classical Japanese beauty culture from Kyoto to San Francisco. In 2008, Vicky Tsai encountered centuries-old beauty rituals in Kyoto and a philosophy of care and harmony that forever altered her life. Founded the following year, Tatcha remasters timeless Japanese beauty preparations into clean, luxurious rituals of self-care that invite you into the moment and back to yourself. Every Tatcha purchase also contributes towards a beautiful future by supporting equal access to education for underserved children around the world.

description.what_it_is: A pro-quality AHA/BHA "facial" that resurfaces skin to visibly reveal greater clarity, improved skin texture and tone, and a more youthful-looking appearance.
description.concerns_text: Dark Spots, Fine Lines, and Wrinkles, and Pores
highlighted_ingredients: 25% AHA Blend (glycolic + (T) tartaric, (L) lactic, (C) citric acids): Exfoliates dead surface skin cells and revs up surface turnover to smooth and brighten the appearance of skin.- Salicylic Acid (BHA) 2%: Penetrates to exfoliate and unclog inside pores as well as on the surface of the skin, providing greater visible skin clarity while soothing redness.- Chickpea Flour: Balances and brightens skin‘s appearance while combating visible dullness.
description.what_else:
Created with all skin in mind, Babyfacial‘s 25 percent AHA/2 percent BHA blend gently exfoliates the pore lining and resurfaces by removing dead skin cells. With an ideal pH level of 3.5, glycolic, tartaric, lactic, citric, and salicylic acids work together to ensure higher efficacy without visible redness and sensitization.Drunk Elephant is committed to using only ingredients that either directly benefit the health of the skin or support the integrity of their formulations. The brand focuses on healthy pH levels, formulations the skin recognizes, small molecular structure that’s easily absorbed, and effective active ingredients that also support the skin’s acid mantle. All of their products are designed to be mixed together—what Drunk Elephant calls making a smoothie. (This is true for all of their products except their sunscreen, Umbra, which sits on top of the skin, protecting it from UV damage.) The result is skin that is reset to its happiest, healthiest state.
Drunk Elephant is a supporter of IEF (International Elephant Foundation) and is cruelty-free.Award Wins: -Glamour, 2019 Glamour Beauty Award -Martha Steward Living, 2019 Living Editor's Pick-Harpers Bazaar, 2019 Anti-Aging Award
description.clinical_results:
In an independent consumer-testing panel of 104 women ages 25 to 55:- 95% found skin appeared revived- 94% found skin to be deeply cleansed and resurfaced- 93% found skin texture baby-soft and smooth- 93% found skin appeared brighter and radiant- 92% found skin appeared to have a healthy glow and boosted clarity- 91% felt skin appeared fresh and youthful- 90% found skin appeared clearer and more even
Clean at SephoraClean at Sephora is a curation of brands committed to evolving the beauty industry. When you see our Clean seal, you can be sure this brand's products are formulated without certain ingredients that are potentially harmful to human health and the environment and also address ingredients clients are concerned about, including phthalates, formaldehyde or formaldehyde releasers, oxybenzone and octinoxate, hydroquinone, triclosan, coal tar, methylisothiazolinone and methylchloroisothiazolinone, insoluble plastic microbeads, and more. For the full list, check out the Ingredients tab.
description.suggested_usage:
-Use once weekly.
-Apply an even layer to clean, dry skin.
-Leave on for 20 minutes.
-Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water and pat dry.
-Follow immediately with Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil (sold separately) for best results.
-Slight tingling may be experienced.
-Tip: Think of T.L.C. Framboos™ Glycolic Night Serum (sold separately) as your nightly maintenance and Babyfacial™ as a weekly deep cleaning.
-Bonus: Drunk Elephant included a mini Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil so you get the best results.-A note to new users: To get the most out of this product, Drunk Elephant recommends starting slow and giving your other potent treatments a break. This probably goes without saying, but if your skin is already in a confused state (i.e., sunburn, redness, or sensitized areas), wait until things are on the calm side before using this product. You‘ve made the investment and Drunk Elephant wants you to get the maximum results. Now go have your cells knocked off.-Top your results off with Drunk Elephant‘s Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil and Drunk Elephant thinks you‘ll have a very satisfied glow.
Precautions:-Babyfacial is not recommended for use by pregnant or nursing mothers. Always check with your doctor before using any new products while pregnant or nursing.

descriptionKo.what_it_is: 피부 표면을 매끄럽게 하여 더 밝고 개선된 피부결과 톤, 그리고 더욱 젊어 보이는 외관을 선사하는 전문가급 AHA/BHA '페이셜' 마스크입니다.
descriptionKo.suggested_usage:
- 주 1회 사용하세요.
- 깨끗하고 건조한 피부에 고르게 펴 발라주세요.
-20분간 그대로 두세요.
- 미지근한 물로 깨끗이 헹군 후 두드려 건조하세요.
- 최상의 효과를 위해 Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil(별도 판매)을 즉시 사용하세요.
- 약간의 따끔거림이 있을 수 있습니다.
- 팁: T.L.C. Framboos™ 글리콜릭 나이트 세럼(별도 판매)은 매일 밤 관리용, Babyfacial™은 주간 딥 클렌징용으로 생각하세요.
- 보너스: Drunk Elephant가 미니 Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil을 포함해 최고의 결과를 제공합니다.
- 신규 사용자 주의사항: 이 제품을 최대한 활용하려면 천천히 시작하고 다른 강력한 트리트먼트는 잠시 쉬는 것을 권장합니다. 피부가 이미 혼란스러운 상태(예: 햇볕 화상, 붉은 기, 민감 부위)라면 진정된 후 사용하세요. 투자한 만큼 최대 효과를 누리시길 바랍니다. 이제 피부 세포가 새로워지는 경험을 해보세요.
- 결과를 Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil로 마무리하면 매우 만족스러운 광채를 얻을 수 있습니다.
주의사항:
- Babyfacial은 임신 중이거나 수유 중인 분에게는 권장하지 않습니다. 임신 또는 수유 중 새로운 제품 사용 전에는 반드시 의사와 상담하세요.
descriptionKo.what_else:
모든 피부 타입을 위해 만들어진 Babyfacial은 25% AHA와 2% BHA 블렌드가 모공 내벽을 부드럽게 각질 제거하고 죽은 피부 세포를 제거하여 피부 표면을 새롭게 합니다. 이상적인 pH 3.5 수준에서 글리콜릭, 타르타릭, 락틱, 시트릭, 살리실산이 함께 작용해 붉은 기와 민감함 없이 높은 효능을 보장합니다. Drunk Elephant는 피부 건강에 직접적으로 이로운 성분이나 제형의 완성도를 지지하는 성분만을 사용합니다. 브랜드는 건강한 pH 수준, 피부가 인식하는 제형, 흡수가 용이한 작은 분자 구조, 그리고 피부 산성막을 지지하는 효과적인 활성 성분에 집중합니다. 모든 제품은 함께 사용하도록 설계되어 Drunk Elephant가 '스무디 만들기'라고 부릅니다. (자외선 차단제인 Umbra를 제외한 모든 제품에 해당하며, Umbra는 피부 위에 자리 잡아 자외선 손상으로부터 보호합니다.) 그 결과 피부는 가장 행복하고 건강한 상태로 리셋됩니다.
Drunk Elephant는 IEF(국제 코끼리 재단)를 후원하며 동물 실험을 하지 않습니다.
수상 내역: -Glamour, 2019 글래머 뷰티 어워드 -Martha Steward Living, 2019 리빙 에디터스 픽 -Harpers Bazaar, 2019 안티에이징 어워드
highlighted_ingredients: 25% AHA 블렌드 (글리콜릭 + (T) 타르타릭, (L) 락틱, (C) 시트릭산): 죽은 각질을 제거하고 피부 표면 재생을 촉진하여 피부를 매끄럽고 밝게 가꿔줍니다.- 살리실산 (BHA) 2%: 모공 내부와 피부 표면을 동시에 각질 제거 및 막힘 해소하여 피부를 더욱 맑고 투명하게 하며 붉은 기를 진정시켜줍니다.- 병아리콩 가루: 피부의 균형을 맞추고 밝게 하며 칙칙함을 완화합니다.

description.suggested_usage:
-Massage onto clean, damp skin using circular motions.

-Rinse off with warm water or leave on for two to three minutes.

-Pat dry.

-Use two to three times a week.

Precautions:
-For external use only.
-Avoid contact with eyes.
-If irritation persists or allergic reaction occurs, rinse off immediately, discontinue use, and consult a physician.
-Keep out of reach of children.
-Sunburn alert: This product contains an alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) that may increase your skin’s sensitivity to the sun and particularly the possibility of sunburn. Use sunscreen, wear protective clothing, and limit sun exposure while using this product and for a week afterward.

description.what_it_is: A serum that immediately replenishes the delicate balance that supports a healthy barrier function of skin—like sunshine’s bronzy color, delivered without the damage.
description.what_else:
Raw, unrefined cocoa powder adds an infusion of good-for-skin polyphenols, platinum peptide acetyl tetrapeptide-17 strengthens and a chronopeptide mimics the antioxidant  benefits of vitamin D. This product is 100 percent free of fragrance, essential oil, irritant, and silicone.

"I’m inside most days. I don’t wear foundation, but I really wanted a little something I could mix into my other products to give my skin some color. The problem was I didn’t want to risk a breakout and I couldn’t find one that fit my suspicious six-free criteria. So, after a few attempts, we landed on a silky, natural-looking, bronzing concentrate. My chemist told me later that they were high-fiving each other in the lab because they had never before been able to create a formulation like this that was silicone-free. D-Bronzi™ is made of vitamins, antioxidants, platinum peptides, and barrier-supportive fatty acids that defend skin from environmental free radicals. It’s a gorgeous sheer bronzer that I formulated with skin health top-of-mind...like sunshine in a bottle without the damage. I hope you fall #drunkinlove!"—Tiffany Masterson, Brand Founder

Drunk Elephant is committed to using only clean ingredients that either directly benefit the skin’s health or support the integrity and effectiveness of the formulations. They never take into account an ingredient’s synthetic or natural status, but instead choose based on its safety and bio-compatibility. You won’t find what Drunk Elephant calls "the suspicious six" of any kind in their products (1. silicones, 2. chemical screens, 3. sensitizing colorants/perfumes, 4. sodium lauryl sulfate (SLS) 5. essential oils, 6. drying alcohols), making them appropriate for all skin. They believe that these six ubiquitous ingredients are at the root of almost every skin issue. When formulating the products, they focus on pH and toxicity, always making sure that the actives are at efficacious levels. This is the Drunk Elephant difference.

Drunk Elephant is a supporter of IEF (International Elephant Foundation) and is cruelty-free.

Clean at Sephora
 When you spot our Clean seal, you can be sure we’ve checked that this brand’s product is made without the ingredients you told us you’d most like to avoid.

Clean at Sephora™ is formulated without:
Sulfates SLS and SLES, parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, triclosan, triclocarban. All skincare, hair, and makeup brands with the Clean Seal have less than one percent of synthetic fragrances.

descriptionKo.what_else:
원료 그대로의 정제되지 않은 코코아 파우더가 피부에 좋은 폴리페놀을 공급하며, 백금 펩타이드 아세틸 테트라펩타이드-17이 강화하고 크로노펩타이드가 비타민 D의 항산화 효과를 모방합니다. 이 제품은 향료, 에센셜 오일, 자극 성분, 실리콘을 100% 배제했습니다.



"저는 대부분 집 안에 있어요. 파운데이션은 안 바르는데, 피부에 색감을 줄 수 있는 뭔가를 다른 제품에 섞어 쓰고 싶었어요. 문제는 트러블 위험이 싫었고, 제가 의심하는 6가지 무첨가 기준에 맞는 제품을 못 찾았죠. 그래서 몇 번 시도 끝에 실키하고 자연스러운 브론징 농축액을 만들었어요. 제 화학자가 나중에 실험실에서 서로 하이파이브를 했다고 하더라고요. 실리콘 없이 이런 포뮬레이션을 만든 건 처음이라면서요. D- Bronzi™는 비타민, 항산화제, 백금 펩타이드, 장벽 강화 지방산으로 환경 유해 활성산소로부터 피부를 보호해요. 손상 없는 병 속 햇살 같은 고운 시어 브론저예요. 여러분도 #drunkinlove 되시길 바랄게요!"—티파니 마스터슨, 브랜드 창립자


Drunk Elephant는 피부 건강에 직접 이롭거나 포뮬레이션의 완성도와 효과를 지지하는 깨끗한 성분만을 사용합니다. 성분의 합성 또는 천연 여부는 고려하지 않고 안전성과 생체 적합성에 따라 선택합니다. Drunk Elephant 제품에는 '의심스러운 6가지'(1. 실리콘, 2. 화학적 자외선 차단제, 3. 자극성 색소/향료, 4. 소듐라우릴설페이트(SLS), 5. 에센셜 오일, 6. 건조 알코올)가 전혀 포함되지 않아 모든 피부에 적합합니다. 이 6가지 성분이 거의 모든 피부 문제의 근원이라고 믿습니다. 제품 개발 시 pH와 독성을 중점으로 하며, 활성 성분은 효과적인 수준으로 유지합니다. 이것이 Drunk Elephant의 차별점입니다.

Drunk Elephant는 IEF(국제 코끼리 재단)를 후원하며 동물 실험을 하지 않습니다.

Clean at Sephora

description.what_else:
Additional ingredients sodium hyaluronate crosspolymer and antioxidant-rich fermented green tea release hydration, defend against everyday stressors, and combat signs of aging. With a pH level of 5.2, Lala Retro™ has the luxurious texture of a rich face cream without feeling suffocating or heavy.

 Drunk Elephant is clean, but in their opinion, “clean” is not enough when it comes to caring for skin. They make “Clean Compatible” skincare. Drunk Elephant is committed to using only ingredients that either directly benefit the skin’s health or support the integrity and effectiveness of their formulations. They never take into account an ingredient’s synthetic or natural status, but instead choose based on biocompatibility. You won’t find what they call the “Suspicious 6” in their products (essential oils, drying alcohols, silicones, chemical sunscreens, fragrances/dyes, SLS) making them, in their opinion, appropriate for all skin. They believe that these six ubiquitous ingredients are at the root of almost every skin issue we see and when entirely removed from one’s routine (“a clean break”), skin can reset and return to a healthy, balanced state. It is equally, if not more, important what we leave out of the products as what we put in. This skin-elimination diet (think Whole30 for your face) inspired the #barewithus Instagram movement, a collection of bare-faced selfies chronicling the Drunk Elephant journeys of people who have found success using the line and renewed confidence in their own skin. When formulating the products, they focus on biocompatibility, pH levels, and safety, always making sure that the active ingredients are at efficacious levels and remain respectful and always supportive of skin’s acid mantle.

Clean at Sephora
 When you spot our Clean seal, you can be sure we’ve checked that this brand’s product is made without the ingredients you told us you’d most like to avoid.

Clean at Sephora™ is formulated without:
Sulfates SLS and SLES, parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, triclosan, triclocarban. All skincare, hair, and makeup brands with the Clean Seal have less than one percent of synthetic fragrances.

Drunk Elephant는 클린 뷰티 브랜드지만, 단순한 ‘클린’만으로는 피부 관리가 충분하지 않다고 생각합니다. 이들은 ‘클린 호환성’ 스킨케어를 만듭니다. Drunk Elephant는 피부 건강에 직접적으로 이롭거나 제형의 효과와 안정성을 지지하는 성분만을 사용하며, 성분의 합성 또는 천연 여부는 고려하지 않고 생체 적합성을 기준으로 선택합니다. 이 브랜드 제품에는 ‘의심스러운 6가지’(에센셜 오일, 건조 알코올, 실리콘, 화학적 자외선 차단제, 향료/염료, SLS)가 포함되어 있지 않아 모든 피부에 적합하다고 봅니다. 이 6가지 성분이 거의 모든 피부 문제의 근원이라 보고 완전히 배제하면 피부가 리셋되어 건강하고 균형 잡힌 상태로 돌아갈 수 있다고 믿습니다. 제품에 무엇을 넣느냐만큼 무엇을 빼느냐도 중요합니다. 이 ‘피부 엘리미네이션 다이어트’(얼굴을 위한 Whole30)에서 영감을 받은 #barewithus 인스타그램 운동은 Drunk Elephant 라인을 사용하며 피부 자신감을 되찾은 사람들의 민낯 셀카 모음입니다. 제품 개발 시 생체 적합성, pH, 안전성에 중점을 두며 활성 성분이 효과적인 수준으로 피부 산성막을 존중하고 지지하도록 항상 신경 씁니다.


Clean at Sephora

 Clean 마크가 붙은 제품은 고객님께서 피하고 싶다고 알려주신 성분이 포함되지 않았음을 보장합니다.

highlighted_ingredients: Encapsulated Retinol: Helps to improve the look of uneven skin tone, and addresses the damage caused by daily exposure to pollutants and other free radicals; encapsulation of the retinol allows it to sit on the surface of the skin longer and release smaller amounts at a time, making it more gentle than traditional retinol treatments.

Avocado: A nutrient-dense fruit rich in antioxidants such as vitamin E and vitamin C, which are known to fight wrinkles and environmental aggressors; contains both avocado oil and avocado extract for the ultimate soothing and nourishing.
Coffeeberry: Packed with antioxidants, coffeeberry (the seed of the coffee plant) helps to revitalize, neutralize free radicals, and soothe.

description.what_else:

The result is brighter, smoother, more awake-looking eyes by morning. This product has been ophthalmologist tested and dermatologist tested.

Clean at Sephora

description.suggested_usage:
To use as a moisturizing sleeping mask:
-After cleansing, apply a pea-size amount to under eye area and gently pat with ring finger into skin for optimal absorption.
-Apply nightly.
-Do not layer with an eye cream.
-Use after cleansing and toning.
-Wash off in the morning.

To use as a daytime eye treatment: 
-Follow instructions above.
-If used during the day, layer an SPF that is safe for eye area on top of formula.

descriptionKo.what_else: 항산화가 풍부한 일본 미치광이 열매로 안정화된 두 가지 비타민 C가 함유된 이 클린하고 피부에 친절한 포뮬러는 투명하고 젊은 빛을 드러내도록 도와줍니다. 순한 과일 AHA가 칙칙하고 고르지 못한 피부를 각질 제거하며, 일본 당귀 뿌리가 다크 스팟과 여드름 흉터의 모습을 줄여줍니다.
highlighted_ingredients: 독특한 20% 비타민 C 블렌드: 빠르게 흡수되는 보습 비타민 C 유도체로 일상적인 활성산소 공격으로부터 노화를 방어하며, 표면 세포 턴오버를 지원해 탄력 있어 보이는 피부를 돕고 수분 수준을 개선합니다; 피부에 더 오래 남아 산화로부터 보호하고 자외선 손상을 줄여 시간이 지날수록 더 밝은 피부로 가꿉니다.
순한 과일 AHA 10%: 부드럽지만 효과적인 산이 각질과 죽은 피부 세포의 축적을 제거해 매끄럽고 빛나는 피부를 만들어 줍니다; 사과, 자몽, 오렌지, 레몬, 라임, 산사나무, 대추 등 7가지 과일에서 추출되었습니다.
일본 당귀 뿌리 추출물: 수세기 동안 한방에서 회복 효과로 귀하게 여겨진 식용 식물로, 다크 스팟, 변색, 여드름 흉터의 원인부터 개선을 돕고, 과다 멜라닌 축적을 분산시켜 눈에 띄게 고른 피부 톤을 선사합니다.

descriptionKo.brand_story: 300년 넘게 일본 게이샤는 지혜와 도자기 같은 아름다운 피부로 찬사를 받아왔습니다. 세대를 거쳐 구전으로 전해진 이들의 뷰티 비밀은 200년 된 문서에서 타차가 재발견했습니다. 동양 미인의 아이콘에 경의를 표하며, 과학자, 학자, 게이샤와 함께 최고의 녹차, 오키나와 홍조류, 쌀겨를 활용한 독자적인 공정을 개발했습니다. 게이샤의 비밀은 타차에 살아 숨 쉽니다.
descriptionKo.clinical_results:
전문가 등급 연구(20명 여성 대상) 결과:

- 4주 후 전반적인 피부 톤이 눈에 띄게 개선

description.what_else:
Untouched by any chemical or fragrance, this highly absorbable oil quickly sinks in to visibly diminish fine lines and wrinkles. Appropriate for all skin, including the most sensitive, this oil contains high concentrations of polyphenols to deliver antioxidant defense against pollution and free radicals.

This oil is free of essential oils and silicones.

Drunk Elephant is committed to using only ingredients that either directly benefit the health of the skin or support the integrity of their formulations. The brand focuses on healthy pH levels, formulations the skin recognizes, small molecular structure that’s easily absorbed, and effective active ingredients that also support the skin’s acid mantle. All of their products are designed to be mixed together—what Drunk Elephant calls making a smoothie. (This is true for all of their products except their sunscreen, Umbra, which sits on top of the skin, protecting it from UV damage.) The result is skin that is reset to its happiest, healthiest state.

Drunk Elephant is a supporter of IEF (International Elephant Foundation) and is cruelty-free.

Awards:
- Influenster, 2019 Best Indie Facial Oil
- Influenster, 2018 Reviewers Choice
description.clinical_results:
In an independent consumer-testing panel of 101 women ages 25 to 55:
- 97% agreed skin felt moisturized
- 97% agreed the oil was gentle and non-irritating
- 94% agreed skin felt softer and nourished
- 90% agreed skin felt rejuvenated and radiant with a healthy glow
- 89% found the oil feels breathable
- 88% agreed skin appeared more youthful

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is a curation of brands committed to evolving the beauty industry. When you see our Clean seal, you can be sure this brand's products are formulated without certain ingredients that are potentially harmful to human health and the environment and also address ingredients clients are concerned about, including phthalates, formaldehyde or formaldehyde releasers, oxybenzone and octinoxate, hydroquinone, triclosan, coal tar, methylisothiazolinone and methylchloroisothiazolinone, insoluble plastic microbeads, and more. For the full list, check out the Ingredients tab.
description.suggested_usage:
-Apply two to three drops evenly onto face, neck, chest, hands, back of arms, or any place needing increased moisture (without any greasy residue) for visibly balanced, glowing, healthy skin.
-Use with Drunk Elephant cleansers, serums, and sun protection as part of your complete Drunk Elephant skincare routine.

-Beauty tip: Apply one to two drops under eyes to minimize the look of fine lines and visibly rejuvenate fragile skin.

Try Drunk Elephant‘s "Sunshine Smoothie" for a healthy-looking, bronzy glow:
-In the palm of your hand, mix one drop of D-Bronzi™, one pump of B-Hydra™ (each sold separately), and one to two drops of Virgin Marula Oil.
-Apply to skin.

descriptionKo.what_else:
어떠한 화학 성분이나 향료도 첨가하지 않은 이 고흡수성 오일은 빠르게 흡수되어 잔주름과 주름을 눈에 띄게 완화합니다. 가장 민감한 피부를 포함한 모든 피부 타입에 적합하며, 폴리페놀 농도가 높아 오염물질과 활성산소로부터 항산화 방어를 제공합니다.

이 오일은 에센셜 오일과 실리콘이 포함되어 있지 않습니다.

Drunk Elephant는 피부 건강에 직접적으로 이로운 성분이나 포뮬러의 완성도를 지원하는 성분만을 사용합니다. 브랜드는 건강한 pH 수준, 피부가 인식하는 포뮬러, 쉽게 흡수되는 작은 분자 구조, 그리고 피부의 산성막을 지원하는 효과적인 활성 성분에 집중합니다. 모든 제품은 함께 사용하도록 설계되어 있으며, Drunk Elephant는 이를 '스무디 만들기'라고 부릅니다. (자외선 차단제인 Umbra를 제외한 모든 제품에 해당하며, Umbra는 피부 위에 보호막을 형성해 자외선으로부터 보호합니다.) 그 결과 피부는 가장 행복하고 건강한 상태로 리셋됩니다.

Drunk Elephant는 IEF(International Elephant Foundation)를 후원하며 동물 실험을 하지 않습니다.

description.ingredient_callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, triclosan, and triclocarban, and contains less than one percent of synthetic fragrances. description.what_else: A wake-up call for your eyes, this cream works wonders for the under-eye area, helping to reduce the appearance of puffiness and dark circles. The added Matrxyl 3000™ peptide can help reduce the appearance of fine lines, while the smooth texture provides a perfect canvas for makeup.
description.suggested_usage:
-Use in the AM and the PM.
-After cleansing, apply a small amount onto finger and gently pat around the contour of the eye.
-Can be combined with the use of other serums; follow with moisturizers.

Precautions:
-Avoid the immediate eye area.
-External use only.
-Caffeine is a fantastic way to reduce puffiness and dark circles caused by a number of lifestyle factors such as lack of sleep, travelling, diet, and high salt intake amongst others. However, dark circles and puffiness can be caused by a number of factors. If you are genetically pre-dispositioned to dark circles caused by pigmentation underneath the eye or puffiness under the eye caused by fat deposits, unfortunately caffeine serum is unlikely to help.

description.what_it_is: An eye cream that instantly delivers a lifted and depuffed look to the eye area while rapidly reducing the appearance of dark circles and fine lines.
description.what_else:
This product is cruelty-free and formulated without gluten and fragrance.

"I have four kids and never seem to get enough sleep. I keep a bottle of Autocorrect in the refrigerator, and massage it in around my eyes every morning while I'm waiting for my coffee to brew. The combination of the cold eye cream, the active ingredients, the light reflecting particles, and the quick massage make me look rested, even if I don't feel that way!"—Sunday Riley
description.suggested_usage:
-Apply two to three pumps morning and evening, and throughout the day as needed.
-Using your ring and middle fingers, lightly tap into the skin around the eye area.

highlighted_ingredients: Nourishing Fruit Salad Blend: A mix of non-fragrant, soothing fruit extracts (blueberry, kiwi, and strawberry) and replenishing fruit oils (cranberry seed oil, acai fruit oil, and watermelon seed oil) that comforts and moisturizes the skin.

description.what_else:
Formulated with antioxidant-rich fruit extracts and a soothing and nourishing blend of African oils, this balm cleanser transforms from an oil to a milk to cleanse and moisturize, leaving behind a dewy glow.

This cleanser is free of essential oils, silicones, and fragrance.

Drunk Elephant is committed to using only ingredients that either directly benefit the health of the skin or support the integrity of their formulations. The brand focuses on healthy pH levels, formulations the skin recognizes, small molecular structure that’s easily absorbed, and effective active ingredients that also support the skin’s acid mantle. All of their products are designed to be mixed together—what Drunk Elephant calls making a smoothie. (This is true for all of their products except their sunscreen, Umbra, which sits on top of the skin, protecting it from UV damage.) The result is skin that is reset to its happiest, healthiest state.

Drunk Elephant is a supporter of IEF (International Elephant Foundation) and is cruelty-free.

Awards:
- Women‘s Health, 2019 Healthy Skin Awards
- Refinery 29, 2019 Feature Story
- InStyle, 2019 InStyle Beauty Award
- Allure, 2019 Best of Beauty

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is a curation of brands committed to evolving the beauty industry. When you see our Clean seal, you can be sure this brand's products are formulated without certain ingredients that are potentially harmful to human health and the environment and also address ingredients clients are concerned about, including phthalates, formaldehyde or formaldehyde releasers, oxybenzone and octinoxate, hydroquinone, triclosan, coal tar, methylisothiazolinone and methylchloroisothiazolinone, insoluble plastic microbeads, and more. For the full list, check out the Ingredients tab.
description.suggested_usage:
-In the evening, on dry skin, use dry fingertips to massage Slaai™ over face and eyes.
-Add water to activate, rinse well with warm water, then pat dry.
-May also be removed with a soft, damp cloth.
-In the morning (optional), one or two times per week, add Drunk Elephant‘s Bamboo Booster™ to Slaai™ for a customized, skin-refining physical exfoliation to aid in the removal of dead skin cells that have accumulated on the surface overnight.

-Beauty tip: If using retinol, Drunk Elephant recommends avoiding Bamboo Booster™ or using with caution, as it can be too much for the skin.

descriptionKo.what_it_is: 피부의 모든 먼지, 메이크업, 자외선 차단제 잔여물까지 녹여내는 혁신적인 클렌징 밤으로, 워터프루프 제품도 깨끗하게 제거해줍니다.
descriptionKo.suggested_usage:
- 저녁에, 마른 피부에 마른 손끝으로 Slaai™를 얼굴과 눈가에 마사지하세요.
- 물을 더해 활성화시키고, 따뜻한 물로 잘 헹군 후 가볍게 두드려 말리세요.
- 부드럽고 촉촉한 천으로도 제거할 수 있습니다.
- 아침에(선택 사항), 주 1~2회 Drunk Elephant의 Bamboo Booster™를 Slaai™에 더해 맞춤형 피부결 정돈 물리적 각질 제거를 하여 밤새 쌓인 각질 제거를 도와줍니다.

- 뷰티 팁: 레티놀 사용 시 Bamboo Booster™는 피부에 자극이 될 수 있으니 피하거나 주의해서 사용하세요.
descriptionKo.what_else:
항산화 성분이 풍부한 과일 추출물과 아프리카 오일의 진정 및 영양 블렌드로 포뮬러된 이 밤 클렌저는 오일에서 밀크로 변해 세안과 보습을 동시에 하며, 촉촉한 광채를 남깁니다.

이 클렌저는 에센셜 오일, 실리콘, 향료가 포함되어 있지 않습니다.

Drunk Elephant는 피부 건강에 직접적으로 이로운 성분이나 포뮬러의 완성도를 지지하는 성분만을 사용합니다. 브랜드는 건강한 pH 수준, 피부가 인식하는 포뮬러, 쉽게 흡수되는 작은 분자 구조, 그리고 피부의 산성막을 지원하는 효과적인 활성 성분에 집중합니다. 모든 제품은 함께 사용하도록 설계되어 있는데, Drunk Elephant는 이를 스무디 만들기라고 부릅니다. (자외선 차단제인 Umbra 제품은 피부 위에 머물며 자외선으로부터 보호합니다.) 그 결과 피부는 가장 행복하고 건강한 상태로 리셋됩니다.

Drunk Elephant는 국제 코끼리 재단(IEF)을 지원하며 동물 실험을 하지 않습니다.

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora는 뷰티 산업의 발전에 헌신하는 브랜드들을 엄선한 컬렉션입니다. Clean 마크가 붙은 브랜드 제품은 인체 건강과 환경에 잠재적으로 해로운 특정 성분 없이 제조되었으며, 프탈레이트, 포름알데히드 및 방출제, 옥시벤존과 옥티녹세이트, 하이드로퀴논, 트리클로산, 콜타르, 메틸이소치아졸리논과 메틸클로로이소치아졸리논, 불용성 플라스틱 마이크로비드 등 고객이 우려하는 성분을 포함하지 않습니다. 전체 목록은 성분 탭에서 확인하세요.

 Precautions:

description.what_it_is:
An anti-aging eye cream that helps strengthen delicate under-eye skin, smooth the look of wrinkles, brighten the eye area, and visibly reduce puffiness.
Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily
description.concerns_text: Fine Lines and Wrinkles, Dark Circles, Puffiness
highlighted_ingredients: CL1870 Peptide Complex™: Fights the look of wrinkles by boosting natural collagen.- Sigesbeckia orientalis extract: Helps skin maintain its density.- Hyaluronic acid: Helps restore suppleness and visibly smooth fine, dry lines.
description.ingredient_callouts: Free of parabens and phthalates, contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance, and comes in recyclable packaging.
description.what_else: This anti-aging eye cream for wrinkles helps strengthen and hydrate delicate under-eye skin to visibly smooth fine lines, brighten dark circles, and reduce crepiness. Designed to improve the tear trough area, its lightweight, fast-absorbing formula delivers lasting moisture for a refreshed, youthful look.
description.clinical_results:
After a 1-week consumer study with 156 women:- 94% agree eye area looks smoother.- 90% agree eye are feels firmer and looks younger.- 92% agree eye area looks brighter.
After a 4-week consumer study with 150 women and 151 women, respectively:- 85% agree this product reduced the appearance of crow’s feet.- 86% agree this product reduced the appearance of undereye lines.
After a 12-week consumer study with 32 women:- 100% agree the eye area feels smoother.
After a 12-week consumer study with 48 women:- 20% saw a reduction in the appearance of under-eye puffiness.
description.suggested_usage: -Apply around eye area, gently massaging into skin.-Use twice a day, morning and evening.
description.brand_story: Maximum Results | Allergy-tested, 100 percent fragrance-free, and always formulated for maximum results—without irritation. Clinique avoids using allergens, irritants, and ingredients that can age or harm skin, while never sacrificing one bit of the effectiveness you need.

descriptionKo.what_it_is:
민감한 눈가 피부를 강화하고 주름을 매끄럽게 하며, 눈가를 밝게 하고 부기를 눈에 띄게 줄여주는 안티에이징 아이크림입니다.
피부 타입: 일반, 건성, 복합성, 지성
descriptionKo.suggested_usage: - 눈가 주변에 부드럽게 마사지하듯 발라줍니다.- 아침과 저녁, 하루 두 번 사용하세요.
descriptionKo.what_else: 이 주름 개선 안티에이징 아이크림은 민감한 눈가 피부를 강화하고 수분을 공급하여 잔주름을 눈에 띄게 매끄럽게 하고, 다크서클을 밝게 하며 피부 처짐을 줄여줍니다. 눈물 고랑 부위를 개선하도록 설계된 가볍고 빠르게 흡수되는 포뮬러가 지속적인 수분감을 제공하여 상쾌하고 젊은 눈가를 완성합니다.
highlighted_ingredients: CL1870 펩타이드 콤플렉스™: 자연 콜라겐 생성을 촉진해 주름 개선에 도움을 줍니다.- 시게스베키아 오리엔탈리스 추출물: 피부 밀도를 유지하는 데 도움을 줍니다.- 히알루론산: 탄력을 회복시키고 잔주름과 건조한 라인을 눈에 띄게 매끄럽게 합니다.
descriptionKo.ingredient_callouts: 파라벤과 프탈레이트 무첨가, 합성 향료 1% 미만 함유, 재활용 가능한 포장재 사용.
descriptionKo.brand_story: 최대 효과 | 알레르기 테스트 완료, 100% 무향료, 자극 없이 최대 효과를 위해 항상 포뮬레이션됩니다. Clinique는 알레르기 유발 성분, 자극 성분, 피부 노화를 촉진하거나 손상시킬 수 있는 성분을 사용하지 않으면서도 필요한 효과는 절대 포기하지 않습니다.
descriptionKo.clinical_results:
156명의 여성 대상 1주 소비자 조사 결과:- 94%가 눈가가 더 매끄럽다고 응답.- 90%가 눈가가 더 탄탄하고 젊어 보인다고 응답.- 92%가 눈가가 더 밝아졌다고 응답.
150명과 151명의 여성 대상 4주 소비자 조사 결과:- 85%가 눈가 잔주름이 줄어든 것을 확인.- 86%가 눈 밑 잔주름이 줄어든 것을 확인.
32명의 여성 대상 12주 소비자 조사 결과:- 100%가 눈가가 더 매끄럽다고 응답.
48명의 여성 대상 12주 소비자 조사 결과:- 20%가 눈 밑 부기 감소를 경험.

description.what_it_is: An alcohol-free cleansing toner infused with real rose petals to remove residual impurities, refine the appearance of pores, and soften skin for a healthy-looking complexion.
description.what_else:
This product is an OK! Magazine 2017 Spring Beauty Award winner.

"Let us count the ways we love this toner: the divine rose scent, the floating petals and, most of all, its ability to deep-clean skin without stripping it."—OK! Magazine
"Infused with real rose petals, Rose Deep Hydration Facial Toner is a heavenly experience for your skin and your senses. This gentle, refreshing toner contains pore-refining rose fruit extract, soothing rosewater, and nourishing rose flower oil, as well as moisture-retaining angelica leaf extract and hyaluronic acid. The result is a healthy, deeply hydrated, and velvety soft complexion."—Lev Glazman, Fresh Co-founder

This product is an Allure Best of Beauty award winner.
description.clinical_results:
In an in-vivo test:

- 100% said it helped clear pollution particles and residual impurities

- 97% felt it softened and refreshed their skin

- 94% reported it left their skin smooth

- 90% felt it was soothing

- 46% increased hydration for 6 hours after application
description.suggested_usage:
-After cleansing, gently sweep over the face and neck with a cotton pad or fingertips.
-Can be used twice a day, morning and night.
description.brand_story: Mixing ancient beauty rituals with modern technology, Fresh offers one-of-a-kind products that perform and pamper. They splurge on everything, and skimp on nothing, to create a collection of high quality—and highly effective—makeup, skin, hair, bath and body products, as well as extraordinary fragrances.

descriptionKo.what_it_is: 알코올 프리 클렌징 토너로, 진짜 장미 꽃잎이 함유되어 남아있는 불순물을 제거하고 모공을 정돈하며 피부를 부드럽게 만들어 건강한 피부결을 완성합니다.

- 아침과 저녁 하루 두 번 사용할 수 있습니다.

이 제품은 OK! 매거진 2017 봄 뷰티 어워드 수상작입니다.

"이 토너를 사랑하는 이유를 꼽자면: 신비로운 장미 향, 떠다니는 꽃잎, 그리고 무엇보다도 피부를 자극 없이 깊게 클렌징하는 능력입니다." — OK! 매거진

"진짜 장미 꽃잎이 함유된 로즈 딥 하이드레이션 페이셜 토너는 피부와 감각 모두에게 천상의 경험을 선사합니다. 이 부드럽고 상쾌한 토너는 모공을 정돈하는 장미 열매 추출물, 진정 효과가 있는 장미수, 영양을 공급하는 장미 꽃 오일, 수분을 유지하는 당귀잎 추출물과 히알루론산을 함유하고 있습니다. 그 결과 건강하고 깊은 보습감과 벨벳처럼 부드러운 피부결을 느낄 수 있습니다." — 레브 글라즈만, Fresh 공동 창립자

이 제품은 얼루어 베스트 오브 뷰티 어워드 수상작입니다.

description.what_it_is: A rich and restorative eye cream featuring a brightening combination of eight peptides, five forms of vitamin C, and cucumber extract for firmer, stronger-looking skin around the eye area.
description.what_else:
This product is free of gluten, fragrance, essential oil, silicone, and irritants. It is vegan and cruelty-free.


Drunk Elephant uses clean ingredients that either directly benefit the skin's health or support the integrity and effectiveness of our formulations. They never take into account an ingredient's synthetic or natural status, but instead choose based on its safety and bio-compatibility. You won't find silicones, chemical sunscreens, sensitizing dyes, perfumes, or fragrant essential oils of any kind in any of their products, making them appropriate for every skin type. Drunk Elephant is a supporter of IEF (International Elephant Foundation) and is cruelty-free.

description.what_it_is: A silky, fine mist moisturizer that can be used under or over makeup for dewy glowing skin anytime, anywhere.
description.what_else:
This product is non-irritating, non-sensitizing, dermatologist tested, and cruelty-free. It is also formulated without mineral oil, synthetic fragrances, urea, DEA, or TEA.

Beauty that gives back: Your purchase of a full-sized Tatcha skincare item will fund a day of school for incredible girls through the brand’s Beautiful Faces, Beautiful Futures partnership with Room to Read.
description.suggested_usage:
-Shake the mist gently and spritz two to three times from six inches away.
-Use before makeup to soothe and hydrate, or use after makeup to set and smooth.
-Can be sprayed on foundation brush or sponge to use with foundation for a dewy glow
-Can be used throughout the day on top of makeup to rehydrate and re-energize the complexion
-Apply on airplanes or during winter for extra hydration.
-Apply on hair for a beautiful sheen or as a detangler for kids.
description.brand_story: For over 300 years, Japan’s geisha have been held in awe for their enduring wisdom and breathtakingly beautiful, porcelain skin. Perfected through centuries, it’s widely believed that their beauty secrets were passed down from one generation of geisha to the next by word of mouth alone. TATCHA rediscovered these coveted daily regimes in a 200-year-old manuscript. In homage to these icons of Eastern beauty, a proprietary process was developed with scientists, scholars, and geisha themselves, involving the very best green teas, Okinawa red algae, and rice bran. The secrets of the geisha live on in TATCHA.

descriptionKo.what_it_is: 언제 어디서나 촉촉하고 빛나는 피부를 위한 실키하고 미세한 미스트 보습제입니다. 메이크업 전후 모두 사용할 수 있습니다.
descriptionKo.suggested_usage:
- 미스트를 부드럽게 흔들고 15cm 거리에서 2~3회 분사하세요.
- 메이크업 전 피부 진정과 수분 공급을 위해 사용하거나, 메이크업 후 고정과 매끄럽게 마무리할 때 사용하세요.
- 파운데이션 브러시나 스펀지에 뿌려 촉촉한 광채를 연출할 수 있습니다.
- 하루 종일 메이크업 위에 뿌려 피부를 재수분하고 활력을 주세요.
- 비행기 탑승 시나 겨울철 추가 수분 공급용으로 사용하세요.
- 머리카락에 뿌려 아름다운 윤기를 주거나 아이들의 엉킨 머리카락을 풀어주는 용도로도 사용할 수 있습니다.
descriptionKo.what_else:
이 제품은 자극 없고 민감하지 않으며, 피부과 테스트를 완료했고 동물 실험을 하지 않았습니다. 미네랄 오일, 합성 향료, 요소, DEA, TEA를 포함하지 않은 포뮬러입니다.

아름다움으로 되돌려 드립니다: Tatcha의 정품 스킨케어 제품 구매 시, 브랜드의 Beautiful Faces, Beautiful Futures와 Room to Read의 파트너십을 통해 교육 기회가 필요한 소녀들의 하루 수업을 지원합니다.
descriptionKo.brand_story: 300년 넘게 일본 게이샤들은 그들의 지혜와 도자기처럼 맑고 아름다운 피부로 찬사를 받아왔습니다. 수세기 동안 완성된 이들의 미용 비법은 구전으로 세대를 이어 내려온 것으로 알려져 있습니다. TATCHA는 200년 된 고문서에서 이 소중한 일상 관리법을 재발견했습니다. 동양 미인의 아이콘에 경의를 표하며, 과학자, 학자, 그리고 게이샤들과 함께 최고의 녹차, 오키나와 홍조류, 쌀겨를 활용한 독자적인 공정을 개발했습니다. 게이샤의 비밀은 TATCHA에 살아 숨 쉬고 있습니다.

description.suggested_usage:
-If you’re new to acids, phase this serum into your routine slowly. Begin using once a week and work your way up to using 2-3 times a week. Once your skin adjusts, use nightly.
-If you’re an acid pro, start off using this serum 2-3 times a week. Then, work your way up to using nightly.
-At night, apply evenly to face and neck—you may experience mild tingling.

Please note:
For external use only. Use as directed. If irritation occurs, reduce frequency of application or discontinue use if persistent. Sunburn Alert: This product contains an alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) that may increase your skin's sensitivity to the sun and particularly the possibility of sunburn. Use a sunscreen, wear protective clothing, and limit sun exposure while using this product and for a week afterward. Avoid eye area. In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately. Keep out of reach of children. This product contains active ingredients; we suggest testing a small amount on forearm before using.

description.what_else:
This product is vegan, noncomedogenic, cruelty-free, and formulated without gluten and silicone. 

Clean at Sephora
 When you spot our Clean seal, you can be sure we’ve checked that this brand’s product is made without the ingredients you told us you’d most like to avoid. 

Clean at Sephora™ is formulated without: 
Sulfates SLS and SLES, parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, triclosan, triclocarban. All skincare, hair, and makeup brands with the Clean Seal have less than one percent of synthetic fragrances.

description.suggested_usage:
-Apply a thin layer to clean skin.
-Slight tingling is normal with this mask as it works to gently exfoliate and resurface the skin.
-Leave on 15 to 20 minutes or until mask is completely dry.
-Rinse with warm water.
-Sensitive skin: leave on five minutes and rinse with warm water.
-For the first five days, use every other day for best results. After day five, use two to three times per week to maintain results.

 Precautions:
-For external use only.
-Although slight tingling is normal with this product, if tingling becomes severe or painful, please remove the mask immediately with warm water.
-Avoid direct contact with eyes or mouth.

description.what_it_is: A skin-barrier-strengthening serum formulated with ceramides & antioxidant-rich avocado to help soothe and visibly reduce redness, dryness, and irritation caused by a weak skin barrier.
description.concerns_text: Dryness, Redness, and Loss of Firmness and Elasticity
highlighted_ingredients: Ceramide 5: A blend of 5 skin-identical ceramides that support the skin barrier & help visibly reduce redness and dryness.- Avocado: A combination of butter + extract for ultimate soothing and nourishing. - Allantoin: A soothing & calming ingredient found naturally occurring in body & nature.
description.ingredient_callouts: This product is vegan, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.
description.what_else: Calming ingredients like avocado, ceramide-5, rice milk, and allantoin visibly reduce redness and soothe irritated or sensitized skin. Skin barrier health is strengthened, resulting in more hydrated, resilient skin. This product has been dermatologist-tested and clinically proven to reduce redness over time.
description.clinical_results:
In a consumer-use study of 30 women, over a 4-week period:-96% said their skin feels soothed & rebalanced.-90% said there is a lasting improvement in my skin dryness.-86% said this serum lessens visible redness


Clean & Planet Aware
Our ambitious curation of beauty made without controversial ingredients from brands dedicated to making meaningful environmental commitments, including sustainable ingredients and sourcing, packaging, corporate commitments, and consumer transparency.
description.suggested_usage:
-After cleansing, toning, and applying eye cream, dispense one to two pumps into your hand.
-Gently pat onto your slightly damp face and neck until fully absorbed.
-Follow with your favorite moisturizer.
-Apply daily, AM and PM.

Recycling Instructions:
-Glow Recipe products are 100 percent recyclable—either at home or through its send-back program with TerraCycle®.
-Recycle the glass jars at home. (Just wash first.)
-Ship the plastic packaging to TerraCycle, where it will be converted into raw materials that can be used for new-product manufacturing.
description.brand_story: Glow Recipe creates clean, fruit-forward, clinically effective skincare for glowing skin. Anchored in Korean skincare philosophies, this sensorial skincare line develops innovative formulas that pair antioxidant-rich fruit with gentle yet powerful actives for real results and your healthiest-looking, glowiest skin yet. Glow Recipe skincare is vegan and cruelty-free.

descriptionKo.what_it_is: 세라마이드와 항산화 성분이 풍부한 아보카도로 약해진 피부 장벽을 진정시키고 붉은 기, 건조함, 자극을 눈에 띄게 완화하는 피부 장벽 강화 세럼입니다.
descriptionKo.suggested_usage:
- 세안, 토닝, 아이크림 사용 후 손에 1~2펌프를 덜어냅니다.
- 약간 촉촉한 얼굴과 목에 부드럽게 두드려 흡수시킵니다.
- 좋아하는 보습제를 덧발라 마무리합니다.
- 아침, 저녁 매일 사용하세요.

재활용 안내:
- Glow Recipe 제품은 100% 재활용 가능하며 가정에서 또는 TerraCycle®의 회수 프로그램을 통해 재활용할 수 있습니다.
- 유리 용기는 가정에서 세척 후 재활용하세요.
- 플라스틱 포장은 TerraCycle로 보내면 신제품 제조에 사용할 원료로 재탄생합니다.
descriptionKo.what_else: 아보카도, 세라마이드-5, 쌀 우유, 알란토인 같은 진정 성분이 붉은 기을 눈에 띄게 줄이고 자극받거나 민감해진 피부를 진정시킵니다. 피부 장벽 건강이 강화되어 더 촉촉하고 탄탄한 피부로 가꿔줍니다. 이 제품은 피부과 전문의 테스트를 거쳤으며 시간이 지남에 따라 붉은 기 완화가 임상적으로 입증되었습니다.
highlighted_ingredients: 세라마이드 5: 피부 장벽을 지지하고 붉은 기과 건조함을 눈에 띄게 완화하는 5가지 피부 유사 세라마이드 혼합물.
아보카도: 집중적인 진정과 영양 케어를 위한 버터와 추출물의 조합.
알란토인: 피부와 자연에 존재하는 진정 및 완화 성분.
descriptionKo.ingredient_callouts: 이 제품은 비건, 크루얼티 프리 제품이며 재활용 가능한 포장재를 사용합니다.
descriptionKo.brand_story: Glow Recipe 는 빛나는 피부를 위한 클린하고 과일 중심적이며 임상적으로 효과가 검증된 스킨케어를 만듭니다. 한국 스킨케어 철학에 뿌리를 둔 이 감각적인 라인은 항산화 성분이 풍부한 과일과 순하지만 강력한 유효 성분을 짝지어, 실제 효과와 가장 건강하고 촉촉하게 빛나는 피부를 선사하는 혁신적인 포뮬러를 개발합니다. Glow Recipe 스킨케어는 비건이며 동물실험을 하지 않습니다.
descriptionKo.clinical_results:
30명의 여성 대상 4주간 소비자 사용 연구 결과:- 96%가 피부가 진정되고 균형 잡힌 느낌이라고 응답.- 90%가 피부 건조함이 지속적으로 개선되었다고 응답.- 86%가 이 세럼이 눈에 띄는 붉은 기을 줄여준다고 응답


클린 & 플래닛 어웨어
논란이 되는 성분 없이 의미 있는 환경 약속을 실천하는 브랜드들의 지속 가능한 성분과 조달, 포장, 기업 약속, 소비자 투명성을 포함한 야심찬 뷰티 큐레이션입니다.

description.what_it_is: A fluffy-light 30% Hyaluronic Acid Complex cream with Pentavitin®, a breakthrough ingredient that provides hydration for up to 72 hours.*
description.concerns_text: Fine Lines and Wrinkles, Dryness, and Dullness
highlighted_ingredients: 30% Hyaluronic Acid Complex: Drenches skin with moisture so it appears supple and smooth.
Pentavitin®: Provides hydration for up to 72 hours—even after cleansing.*
Hydrolyzed Silk: Derivative of silk that leaves skin feeling silky soft and smooth.
description.ingredient_callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance.
description.what_else:
Drench your skin with a 30% hyaluronic acid complex that plumps the look of skin with moisture. Pentavitin® provides hydration for up to 72 hours—even after cleansing.* The look of fine lines and wrinkles is visibly reduced—leaving a silky, hydrated, and more youthful-looking complexion.

*In a 28-day study with application of a one percent Pentavitin® formulation, skin remained hydrated for 72 hours.
description.suggested_usage:
-Apply twice daily to your face and neck.
-For external use only.
description.brand_story: BREAKTHROUGH FORMULAS. ASTONISHING RESULTS. | Inspired by my family’s 19thcentury Hungarian spa heritage, I use 21stcentury ingredients and technologies to create my complete skincarecollection. Ingredients sourced from all over the world are formulated at the highest percentages possible to provide maximum results for brighter, clearer, younger-looking skin.

description.what_it_is: A vegan, buttery, collagen sleeping cream that delivers essential nutrients and nurtures the skin for a dewy, cushioned glow by morning.
description.concerns_text: Loss of Firmness and Elasticity, Fine Lines and Wrinkles, and Dullness and Uneven Texture
highlighted_ingredients: Patented Alguronic Acid: Naturally sourced and sustainably produced from algae, it’s clinically shown to visibly minimize appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, as well as boost the benefits of other active ingredients.
Exclusive Active Vegan Collagen™: High-concentration vegan collagen that helps to strengthen and condition the skin to visibly improve texture and suppleness.

Skin-Mimicking Ceramides and Mary Thistle: Helps to support skin barrier function, increasing hydration, reducing the appearance of wrinkles, increasing the look of firmness and has antioxidants to protect skin from the appearance of oxidative aging.
description.ingredient_callouts: Free of sulfates SLS and SLES, parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, triclosan, and triclocarban, and contains less than one percent of synthetic fragrances. This product is also vegan.
description.what_else: Sleeping Collagen works overnight, during skin's optimal recovery time. With exclusive alguronic acid, Active Vegan Collagen™, skin-mimicking ceramides, and Mary Thistle—skin is left more hydrated, softer, supple, and radiant. Skin is also protected from moisture loss and visible damage from aggressors.
description.clinical_results:
In self-assessments of 85 women using the product once nightly, after 10 days of use:
- 98% said skin felt and looked hydrated
- 94% said skin looked and felt deeply moisturized
- 95% said skin appeared softer and more supple
description.suggested_usage:
-After cleanser, apply a pea-sized amount to face, neck, and décolleté in the evening.
-A tranquil blend of natural, stress-relieving notes released during application also helps promote restful sleep.
-Due to the nutrient-rich formula and buttery texture, only a pea-sized amount is needed per use.

피부 모사 세라마이드와 마리 실슬: 피부 장벽 기능을 지원하여 수분을 증가시키고 주름의 외관을 줄이며 탄력 있는 피부로 가꾸고, 산화 노화로부터 피부를 보호하는 항산화 효과가 있습니다.

description.what_it_is: A clean, cutting edge formula with one percent vegan retinol and superfood-rich ingredients to diminish the look of fine lines, wrinkles, and sun damage.
description.concerns_text: Dark spots, Fine lines and wrinkles, Dryness
highlighted_ingredients: 1.0% retinol: Imroves the look and feel of uneven skin tone and texture and addresses the damage from daily exposure to UV rays, pollution, or other free radicals.
Triple Peptide Blend: Helps visibly firm and strengthen, boosting the visible results of retinol.
Vitamin F: Works to improve the appearance of texture and suppleness and calms signs of sensitivity.
description.ingredient_callouts: Free of sulfates SLS and SLES, parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, triclosan, and triclocarban, and contains less than one percent of synthetic fragrances. This product is also vegan, cruelty-free, and gluten-free.
description.what_else:
Retinol and supportive peptides restore bounce, resilience and clarity to skin while helping to even tone and texture without redness and irritation. Vitamin F and a curated blend of oils replenish lipids and moisture while antioxidant-packed ingredients defend against environmental stressors.

 Drunk Elephant is committed to using only ingredients that either directly benefit the skin’s health or support the integrity and effectiveness of our formulations. They never take into account an ingredient’s synthetic or natural status, but instead choose based on its biocompatibility. You won’t find what they call the "Suspicious 6" in their products (essential oils, drying alcohols, silicones, chemical screens, fragrance/dyes, and SLS,) making them, in their opinion, appropriate for all skin. They believe that these six ubiquitous ingredients are at the root of almost every skin issue we see. When formulating the products, they focus on pH levels and safety, and always making sure that the active ingredients are at efficacious levels. This is the Drunk Elephant difference.

Drunk Elephant is a supporter of IEF (International Elephant Foundation) and is cruelty-free.
description.clinical_results:
In an independent consumer testing panelof 45 women ages 25 to 55:
- 100% testers agreed skin clarity was improved
- 94% testers agreed skin texture felt smoother
- 88% of testers agreed skin felt firmer

Clean at Sephora
 When you spot our Clean seal, you can be sure we’ve checked that this brand’s product is made without the ingredients you told us you’d most like to avoid. 

Clean at Sephora™ is formulated without: 
Sulfates SLS and SLES, parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, triclosan, triclocarban. All skincare, hair, and makeup brands with the Clean Seal have less than one percent of synthetic fragrances.
description.suggested_usage:
-Morning or night, apply a pea-sized amount to clean, dry face, avoiding the eye area.
-May be mixed with any Drunk Elephant cream or oil.
-Limit initial use to once or twice a week, gradually increasing frequency to every other night, and then every night as tolerated.
-Always use a broad-spectrum sunscreen.
-TIP: Mix with B-Hydra™ for an extra shot of hydration and vitamin B.

descriptionKo.what_it_is: 1% 비건 레티놀과 슈퍼푸드 성분이 함유된 클린하고 최첨단 포뮬러로 잔주름, 주름, 자외선 손상 흔적을 완화해줍니다.
descriptionKo.suggested_usage:
- 아침 또는 저녁, 깨끗하고 건조한 얼굴에 완두콩 크기만큼 덜어 눈가를 피해 발라주세요.
- Drunk Elephant의 크림이나 오일과 섞어 사용할 수 있습니다.
- 처음에는 주 1~2회 사용을 권장하며, 점차 격일, 이후 매일 사용으로 늘려주세요.
- 항상 자외선 차단제를 함께 사용하세요.
- TIP: B- Hydra™와 섞어 수분과 비타민 B를 추가로 공급하세요.
descriptionKo.what_else:
레티놀과 보조 펩타이드가 피부 탄력과 생기를 회복시키고, 붉은 기과 자극 없이 피부 톤과 결을 고르게 가꿔줍니다. 비타민 F와 엄선된 오일 블렌드가 피부 지질과 수분을 보충하며, 항산화 성분이 환경 스트레스로부터 피부를 보호합니다.

Drunk Elephant는 피부 건강에 직접적으로 이로운 성분 또는 포뮬러의 효과와 안정성을 지원하는 성분만을 사용합니다. 합성 또는 천연 여부에 관계없이 생체 적합성을 기준으로 선택하며, '의심스러운 6가지'(에센셜 오일, 건조 알코올, 실리콘, 화학적 자외선 차단제, 향료/염료, SLS)는 제품에 포함하지 않아 모든 피부에 적합하다고 봅니다. 이 6가지 성분이 대부분 피부 문제의 원인이라고 믿으며, 제품 개발 시 pH와 안전성, 활성 성분의 효과적 농도에 집중합니다. 이것이 Drunk Elephant만의 차별점입니다.

Drunk Elephant는 국제 코끼리 재단(IEF)을 후원하며 크루얼티 프리 브랜드입니다.
highlighted_ingredients: 1.0% 레티놀: 고르지 못한 피부 톤과 결을 개선하고 자외선, 오염, 기타 활성산소로 인한 손상을 케어합니다.
트리플 펩타이드 블렌드: 피부 탄력을 눈에 띄게 강화하고 레티놀 효과를 증진합니다.
비타민 F: 피부결과 탄력을 개선하고 민감한 피부 진정에 도움을 줍니다.

Clean at Sephora
 Clean Seal이 붙은 제품은 고객님이 피하고 싶어하는 성분을 배제했음을 보증합니다.

description.suggested_usage:
-Apply to wet skin and gently massage in.

Precautions:
